channel.title: Tuoi Tre News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Tuoi Tre News (tuoitrenews.vn)

item.title: Australia's top central banker says March rate hike possible
item.description: SYDNEY -- Australia's top central banker on Tuesday said an increase in interest rates was possible this month if the policy-making board decided inflation expectations were at risk of becoming unanchored, and markets should be aware of that.

item.title: Airline stocks remain under pressure; Asian carriers see surge in demand, prices jump
item.description: SYDNEY/HONG KONG - Asian airline shares remained under pressure on Tuesday as the U.S. and Israeli conflict with Iran escalated, with carriers closely monitoring fuel price spikes and many seeing a surge in bookings as passengers switch from Middle Eastern airlines.

item.title: Airline passenger helps save 7-year-old girl bitten by venomous krait in Vietnam
item.description: A seven-year-old girl from Hue City in central Vietnam narrowly escaped death after being bitten by a Malayan krait while sleeping, in a race against the ‘golden 24 hours’ that was won only after five vials of antivenom were urgently airlifted from Ho Chi Minh City to Hue with the help of a volunteer airline passenger.

item.title: Flowers, music, and soldiers at funeral of drug lord
item.description: The notorious Mexican drug lord Nemesio Oseguera was laid to rest in a simple grave Monday in a ceremony that featured trucks overflowing with flowers, traditional music and dozens of masked soldiers in armored vehicles.

item.title: Vietcombank chairman nominated as National Assembly candidate in Ho Chi Minh City
item.description: Nguyen Thanh Tung, chairman of the board of directors of state-run Vietcombank, has been nominated as a candidate for the 16th National Assembly in Ho Chi Minh City.

item.title: Vietnam’s PVGas Trading declares force majeure on LPG deliveries after Saudi supply disruption
item.description: PVGas Trading, a unit of state-run PetroVietnam Gas (PVGas), has declared force majeure on liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) deliveries to customers in southern Vietnam after its Middle Eastern supplier suspended shipments, the company said in a notice.

item.title: Vietnam fines 193 drivers in one day in railway crossing crackdown
item.description: Vietnam’s Traffic Police Department fined 193 drivers for violations at railway crossings on Monday as part of a nationwide enforcement campaign ordered by the Ministry of Public Security.

item.title: 4 tonnes of untraceable food seized in north-central Vietnam
item.description: Police in Thanh Hoa Province, north-central Vietnam have teamed up with relevant forces to discover and seize some four metric tons of food products of unknown origin in a crackdown on unsafe food trading in the province.

item.title: 13 foreign nationals caught illegally gambling in Nha Trang hotel basement
item.description: Police in Khanh Hoa Province, south-central Vietnam caught 13 foreign nationals gambling illegally in a hotel basement in Nha Trang late on Sunday, seizing US$3,500 in cash and documents related to the operation.

item.title: International tourists embrace hands-on river experiences in Phu Quoc
item.description: Foreign visitors to Phu Quoc Special Zone, an island in An Giang Province, Vietnam’s Mekong Delta, are increasingly seeking immersive activities along the Cua Can River, including traditional fishing and riverside tree planting, in addition to the island’s famed beaches.
